sections.text: Full speed ahead! NVIDIA’s juggernaut has passed Team Turducken, and the climb toward the strongholds continues. Jean-François Puget and his NVARC3 teammates hold the advantage over Turducken in this reading. Above them, Yi-Chia Chen and Tufa Labs still command the heights. Can they withstand the siege?

sections.heading: The road from eighth to fourth
sections.text:
The juggernaut advances in bursts. Tong Hui Kang’s leaderboard history shows large steps in NVARC3’s public best through October. That history records changes in the public best, not the result of every submission.

The NVIDIA crew has gained ground since Saturday’s profile. Sunday brought a major advance and the pass on Turducken; Monday’s smaller improvement stretched the advantage. Next up is xz. The dated box score carries the exact positions and scores.

sections.heading: The strongholds hold—for now
sections.text:
Yi-Chia Chen @ Fields Model and Tufa Labs have held their scores across the comparison window. There is still plenty of mountain between the leaders and the machines below.

Farther down, Grigoriy Zatravkin & co and the last dance have both climbed. The chasing pack is tightening, and Turducken’s cushion has narrowed.

sections.heading: A leap out of the pack
sections.text:
Then lightning from the pack: infinity’s score leap carried it from deep in the field into the top ten in a single board reading. Other climbers have since moved ahead, but infinity remains high on the ridge.

Md Boktiar Mahbub Murad and The ARChitects also improve. The strongholds may be standing still; the field beneath them is anything but settled. Who will still be standing when the private board lands?
Disclosure: ARC Daily Digest editor Mark Barney competes on Team Turducken.
